_comment: Registry for /alternatives/<slug>/ pages (daily alternatives routine, owner rules 2026-11-13). A page renders ONLY when its route is listed here. Listing a route turns on: the two vendor CTAs, the outbound-link guard (the only external links allowed are officialHosts), no Mediavine ads, no entity/referral auto-links, and no external links in the site footer. One row per page: {"route": "/alternatives/<slug>/", "vendorHost": "<apex host of the subject product>", "officialHosts": ["<every exact host the page links>"]}. Content lives in src/data/alternatives.json.
